producer: work package T (Build 14): local procedural asset factory, no photo sources yet

conventions.colour_space: albedo, sprites, decals and skies are sRGB; _n and _m maps are linear data
conventions.tile: size_m = metres covered by one repeat [u, v]; seamless in both directions (facades and kerb: u only, v spans the storey)
conventions.normal_map: <name>_n.webp, tangent space, OpenGL convention (+Y up, green = up)
conventions.material_map: <name>_m.webp at half resolution: R = cavity AO, G = roughness, B = height (0.5 = mean)
conventions.sprite: straight (non-premultiplied) alpha, colour bled into transparent texels (safe for mipmaps/linear filtering); size_m = quad size in metres; pivot_uv = [u, v] measured from the top-left corner = the ground/foot point
conventions.tiles_x: true: the sprite repeats horizontally, size_m[0] is the period
conventions.frames: spectators and crowd strips come as _a/_b frames of the same size and pivot; alternate them for a cheering loop
conventions.decal: alpha-blended overlay; road decals: size_m = [across, along] the road, top of the image points away from the approaching rider
conventions.sky: equirectangular upper hemisphere: u = azimuth 0..360 deg (wraps), v = 0 at the zenith .. 1 at the horizon; sun disk not drawn
conventions.leafcard: foliage card for 3D instanced trees; twig base at bottom centre unless pivot_uv says otherwise
